system.description:
Before your Embrace, you received the traditional Giovanni Proxy Kiss. You begin play with a partial blood bond to another Giovanni Kindred (usually not your sire), and you gain the Basic Potence level Prowess in addition to your other Disciplines, with access to learn the first Intermediate level of Potence with your starting Discipline levels. Other Giovanni tend to be reassured that you were Embraced in "the proper Giovanni fashion."

This Merit may be taken a second time for a total of 8 Traits, representing very long service as a ghoul: you gain the Basic Fortitude Discipline Endurance as well, and you come into play with partial bonds to two Giovanni Kindred, or a full bond to one (at Storyteller discretion).
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
